intro: Afghan culture is rich in poetry, music, carpets and hospitality.

chapters.title: Poetry and arts
text: Rumi was born in Balkh in 1207. Afghan carpets, embroidery and kite flying are famous. Music was banned under the Taliban.

chapters.title: Food
text: Kabuli pulao, rice with carrots, raisins and lamb, is the national dish. Mantu dumplings and bolani flatbreads are favourites, served with green tea.

keyTerms.meaning: A rice dish cooked in broth.
